title: Wheels and things that roll
examples: Teacher, why do toy cars need wheels?
What is the difference between rolling and sliding?
Can things roll if they don't have wheels?

explain.say: Say, wheels and axles help things move easily.
A wheel spins around a rod called an axle.
Rolling uses the wheel spinning on the axle.
Rolling is much easier than sliding across the floor.
When you push a toy car, it rolls easily on its wheels.
When you push a heavy box, it is hard to slide it.

items: Sliding takes a lot of push
Rolling is much easier to do

faq.a: Cars have wheels so they can roll easily over the road. Rolling uses less pushing power than sliding.
asks: What is the purpose of wheels on a car?
Why are wheels better than just dragging?
Do wheels help things move faster?

faq.q: Is rolling always better than sliding?
faq.a: Yes, for moving things over a long distance, rolling is usually much easier. It uses less energy.
asks: Can sliding ever be better than rolling?
When should I use wheels instead of pushing?

faq.q: What is the difference between a wheel and an axle?
faq.a: The wheel is the round part that spins. The axle is the straight rod that the wheel spins around.
asks: Are the wheel and axle the same thing?
Which part spins on the other part?
What connects the wheel to the rod?

faq.q: Do all things that move have wheels?
faq.a: No, some things slide or use different ways to move. But wheels help things move over flat ground.
asks: Can I move something without wheels?
What if the ground is bumpy?
Do I always need wheels to move?

faq.a: Friction is the rubbing force between two surfaces. Rolling wheels help to reduce this friction.

facts: Wheels spin around a straight rod called an axle.
Rolling motion is much easier than sliding motion.
Friction is the force that resists movement between surfaces.
Many machines use wheels and axles to work.

quiz.say: A toy car moves smoothly because it uses:
quiz.why: Rolling allows the car to move easily because the wheels spin on the axles.

wrong.0: Sliding creates too much rubbing force, making it hard to move.
wrong.1: Pushing is the action, but rolling is the way the wheels help the push.
wrong.2: The axle is the rod, but the wheel is the part that actually spins.

quiz.say: If you push a heavy box, it is easier to move it by:
quiz.why: Rolling is better because it uses less energy than sliding over the ground.

wrong.0: Pushing hard is what you do, but rolling is the method that helps the push.
wrong.2: Sliding makes the box rub against the ground, which is very hard.
wrong.3: Lifting uses too much muscle power for a heavy box.

quiz.say: The straight rod that the wheel spins on is called the:
quiz.why: The axle is the straight rod that goes through the center of the wheel.

wrong.0: Friction is the force that makes things rub, not the part that connects them.
wrong.2: The wheel is the round part that spins, not the rod itself.
wrong.3: The surface is what the object moves across.
